note: 華華しい is a valid variant but 華々しい is the standard spelling. It has the same JMdict entry ent_seq 1600960 sense 0, glossed brilliant, splendid, glorious, magnificent, and spectacular.
不況 is a standard term for an economic depression, recession, or slump; the stated major-contraction context distinguishes it from a mild downturn.
ブーム often means a craze or fad. 好況 is the standard term for prosperous economic conditions or a market boom; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1277620 sense 0.
不明瞭 means unclear, faint, or indistinct, and tối tăm covers dark or obscure appearances in this sense.
bình is a general vessel. Bình có vòi naturally specifies a serving jug with a spout, as described.
bản án often means the court's judgment or sentence, including punishment. Phán quyết better names the decision on the facts of a case.
扇ぐ is an uncommon spelling for the incite sense. 煽る is the standard verb for instigating or stirring up an incident; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1391630 sense 2.
túi is a general bag or pouch. Túi màng is a natural technical Vietnamese phrase for a membrane-bound compartment in a cell.
辞表 specifically names a written letter of resignation, while the English definition also includes oral declarations. I found no verified single Japanese term covering both.
いつか is a natural equivalent for an unspecified future time, as in いつかまた会おう; past-time uses are resolved by context.
覚書 often refers to a formal memorandum or agreement. メモ is the common Japanese noun for a written business memo; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1133830 sense 0.
đỏ means red generally. Đỏ tươi expresses a brilliant bright red and is closer to scarlet than the bare color word.
肖像 and chân dung can cover portraits in other media. 肖像画 is a portrait painting, verified in JMdict ent_seq 1351470 sense 0; tranh chân dung specifies the same medium in Vietnamese.
専門的知識 emphasizes expert knowledge and omits skill. 専門性 means expertise or specialization more generally; verified in JMdict ent_seq 2101430 sense 0.
翔る is highly literary. 飛翔 is the standard noun or suru-verb for flight or soaring; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1485610 sense 0.
bụi can mean a single bush. Bụi rậm is the Vietnamese term for a dense growth of shrubs or small trees.
職人 and nghệ nhân are suitable terms for a skilled artisan. Japanese and Vietnamese do not grammatically mark the artisan's sex, but both terms can refer to a man.
目覚める has a straightforward sense of waking from sleep, and tỉnh dậy is the natural Vietnamese equivalent.
留める has a standard sense of fastening or pinning something in place, and ghim is the direct Vietnamese verb.
vua means king generally and omits the title's Muslim-state context. Quốc vương Hồi giáo is a clear Vietnamese description of the ruler defined here.
十字路 and ngã tư imply a four-way junction. 交差点 is a general intersection, verified in JMdict ent_seq 1592970 sense 0; giao lộ is the Vietnamese term for a road intersection.
インストラクター often means a practical-skills instructor. 教師 is the general teacher or instructor term; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1237130 sense 0.
コンディション is a general condition. 病状 directly means a patient's condition or state of disease; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1490350 sense 0.
監査役 is a specific statutory role in Japanese companies. 監査人 is the general person who audits accounts; verified in JMdict ent_seq 2774760 sense 0.
小屋 and lán are suitable words for a small temporary shelter structure, even though Japanese 小屋 can also describe a permanent hut.
vỏ is a general cover or shell. Bao kiếm is the natural Vietnamese term for a sword's scabbard.
gậy is a general stick or cane. Gậy gộc is a heavier stick or club used as a weapon or plaything.
vỏ means a shell or covering generally. Lốp is the standard Vietnamese word for a vehicle tyre.
suốt usually means a thread bobbin. Ống cuốn dây describes a spool or reel for thread, wire, or cable more generally.
vô cùng is often an intensifier meaning extremely. Vô tận directly means endless or without end.
たか and diều hâu are standard equivalents for a hawk; the falcon translation in the Japanese gloss is a separate related use.
いもむし commonly denotes a hairless caterpillar and sâu is a general worm or larva. The English definition spans all butterfly and moth larvae, and no single natural Japanese form matches that scope.
壁龕 is a precise architectural term for a wall niche, and hốc is a natural Vietnamese word for a recess or cavity.
ボウル often means a Western mixing or salad bowl. 鉢 is the general Japanese bowl for holding food; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1477090 sense 0.
ファクシミリ is correct but uncommon in everyday speech. ファックス is the standard abbreviation for a fax document; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1108180 sense 0.
激怒 and thịnh nộ both mean violent, uncontrolled anger; the Vietnamese term is somewhat formal but precise.
ほっぺた is colloquial and sometimes childish. 頬 is the standard neutral word for cheek; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1584160 sense 0.
農耕 emphasizes farming or cultivation. 農業 is the general Japanese term for agriculture; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1470660 sense 0.
汚職 often centers on public-official bribery or graft. 腐敗 has a broader institutional sense of corruption or depravity; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1497870 sense 1.
月刊誌 specifically means a monthly magazine. 月刊 is a general monthly publication or issue; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1255530 sense 0.
